steps.content: Two shadows are locked in struggle at the center of the room.
One appears to be holding some kind of weapon, hacking at the other shadow again and again.

steps.speaker: Furious Shadow
steps.content: You got everyone killed! I couldn't protect them... It's all your fault!
No matter how deadly, his attacks are all in vain.
The deranged shadow is shredded, only to reform moments later. The slaughter has repeated countless times, until your arrival.
Only when you draw closer do you hear his frenzied whispers amid the roars and destruction.

steps.speaker: Deranged Shadow
steps.content: There's no escape... She planned it all... It was over... the moment we stepped onboard...

steps.speaker: Deranged Shadow
steps.content: The Abyss is among us... It's too late...
